in_latin.name: Hamish
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Scoticum, origine a nomen Gaelico Haimh
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Scoticum, origine a nomen Gaelico Haimh, significans 'agnus' vel 'lupus'. Haimh est nomen masculinum in lingua Gaelica, a quo derivatur nomen Hamish in lingua Scotica. Nomen Hamish in Scotia et insulis Britannicis usurpatur, et in Christianitate significat 'agnus Christi' vel 'novus agnus'
